europe_now.summary: Russian forces have launched intensified strikes on civilian areas, increasing casualties and humanitarian pressure. The escalation has raised urgent security concerns across Europe, prompting calls for greater air defence support.

top_stories.summary: European supporters of Ukraine gathered as Russian missile attacks intensified, straining air defence supplies. The live coverage highlighted growing concerns over the continent's security amid the escalating conflict.
